levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: book chain from the compiler's own preface: no Imam and no saying; each route ends where the text ends it

«ما كان فيه عن محمد بن عذافر» names the book's author as its origin; the route through «أبي» is not completed from memory, the father's own chain is not written here (rule 8, rule 9). needs_ruling: the author of a cited book (rule 11)
«والحميري جميعا عن محمد بن الحسين» — «جميعا» applies to al-Humayri's route only; Sa'd's route is written to Sa'd and not extended
«رضي الله عنهما» is a blessing, left out
